title: FrameScope: Temporal Data Valuation for Stream Active Learning in Autonomous Vehicle Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.28672v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autonomous vehicles operate in dynamic, ever-changing environments where new scenarios and edge cases constantly emerge. As a result, static learning models are inadequate for ensuring safe and reliable operation. Continuous learning is essential for adapting to these evolving conditions and maintaining robust performance across diverse real-world settings. However, autonomous vehicles generate massive streams of visual data during operation, and existing continuous learning approaches typically rely on heuristic sampling methods that fail to capture temporal dynamics, often overlooking critical learning opportunities or selecting redundant frames. In this paper, we introduce FrameScope, a temporal data valuation framework for continuous learning in autonomous vehicles. translated_title: FrameScope：面向自动驾驶汽车系统流式主动学习的时间数据价值评估框架
translated_abstract: 自动驾驶汽车运行在动态、不断变化的环境中，新的场景和边缘案例不断涌现。因此，静态学习模型不足以确保安全可靠的运行。持续学习对于适应这些不断演变的条件、并在多样化的真实世界环境中保持稳健性能至关重要。然而，自动驾驶汽车在运行过程中会产生海量的视觉数据流，而现有的持续学习方法通常依赖启发式采样方法，无法捕捉时间动态特性，往往会忽视关键的学习机会或选择冗余的帧。在本文中，我们提出了FrameScope，一个面向自动驾驶汽车持续学习的时间数据价值评估框架。FrameScope将神经正切核（Neural Tangent Kernel）理论扩展到时间域，能够对流式视觉数据进行有原则的价值评估。与以云端为中心的传输（原文在此处截断）
tldr: FrameScope通过将神经正切核理论扩展到时间域，提出了一个时间数据价值评估框架，为自动驾驶汽车流式视觉数据的持续学习提供了有原则的帧选择方法，克服了传统启发式采样无法捕捉时间动态、易遗漏关键学习机会的缺陷。
en_tdlr: FrameScope extends neural tangent kernel theory to temporal domains, introducing a principled temporal data valuation framework for continuous learning that overcomes the limitations of heuristic sampling in selecting informative frames from streaming visual data in autonomous vehicle systems.
